systems.platform: optical fibre backbone with last-mile connectivity
systems.owner: NITA-U, under the Ministry of ICT and National Guidance
systems.tiers: 63 districts prioritised and 2,800 last-mile public institutions countrywide, security among the sectors; in Kanungu, 20 agencies including Kanungu Police, with last-mile connectivity to enable police posts to access high-speed internet

note: Connectivity only: the fibre extension launched in Kanungu on 1 December 2025 is to connect Kanungu Police and enable police posts to reach the internet; no station record system is named, so no fact.
